verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents both online payments and 'Process payments with a device' (terminal-style in-person processing) under the same merchant/API model, implying shared merchant balances and reporting infrastructure (deposits, webhooks). However, there is no explicit documentation of a tap-to-pay SDK or an explicit statement confirming that in-person device payments settle into the exact same balance/reporting pipeline as online payments. missing for 10: explicit tap-to-pay SDK support, explicit confirmation that device/terminal payments unify with online payments in settlement and reporting, independent corroboration of in-person hardware integration.
